verdict.rationale: Svelte is a UI framework, so native desktop targeting is a fair axis, but the evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a desktop target, adapter, or native runtime. The only related item is one community report of using Svelte as the UI for a cross-platform app with a Rust backend. That is a user-side arrangement rather than a capability Svelte itself provides, and SPA/static output modes are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build native desktop applications by reusing my framework's component model and tooling
